thread:
mike_release: Heads-up — planning a coordinated roll tonight at 23:00 PDT during the 2h quiet window. Runtime -> v1.8.2, router header-split change, and console schema bump all in the same wave. Need to pin API to v2.3.0 for canary so console doesn't flake. Any blockers?

vijay_runtime: runtime side ok for v1.8.2, fyi KV eviction param changed. If we see a traffic spike we should have a rollback flag and autoscale ready. Suggest warming cache before traffic shift.

jess_console: console schema is backward-compatible for UI, but analytics mapping will break on some older logs — that could surface as ingestion 5xxs. Recommend gating analytics-related schema fields.

charlie_router: router change requires header-strip toggle — we can scope it to canary only. I'll create a 'router-canary-23' flag. Do we have an automated compatibility test?

sara_dev: I can run a quick e2e against staging with pinned api v2.3.0 + console v1.5.4. How long is the canary window?

mike_release: plan: canary 20% for 15m -> 50% for 30m -> full. Rollback criteria: 95th percentile latency delta > 30ms OR error rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m. Also immediate rollback if ingestion 5xxs spike.

deploybot: @channel Deploybot will start canary in ~10m. Deploy manifest: runtime:v1.8.2, router:header-split=canary, console:v1.5.4-schema-bump, api:v2.3.0-pinned. Streaming logs to #release-logs. :rocket: 

vijay_runtime: Add env KV_EVICT_TTL=60 and kv-prefetch=on for canary nodes. Emit metric runtime.kv.evictions and runtime.kv.hit_ratio to the canary dashboard.

jess_console: Also add regression test suite 'console-schema-smoke' to preflight. It checks analytics mapping + fallback paths.

charlie_router: header-strip enabled on cluster router-canary-23 only. Will not flip on main router until we green.

sara_dev: starting e2e now with pinned API. Will post failures inline.

sara_dev: e2e found spike in ingestion — analytics mapper throwing NPEs causing 5xxs intermittently. Snippet: ```ERROR analytics.mapper.MapTransformer - NullPointer at MapTransformer.java:68
payload: {"events": 23, "user": null}```

mike_release: Hold full rollout. Do not advance traffic. Rollback console schema in canary to v1.5.3. We need a quick patch that guards nulls and better test coverage.

deploybot: Rolling back console in canary to v1.5.3 now. Pausing traffic shifts. Will post completion.

vijay_runtime: Monitoring runtime metrics and canary dashboards. If 95th latency > 200ms or error rate >0.5% i'll flip autoscale and alert oncall.

mike_release: Thanks. Next steps/TODOs: 1) add schema gating to release notes + release checklist, 2) enforce api pin in console's deploy spec, 3) add 'console-schema-smoke' to deploybot preflight, 4) fix mapper NPE and ship patch, 5) re-run canary after patch. I'll create the follow-up ticket.

deploybot: console rollback complete in canary. Traffic frozen. Notifying @release-team.
